resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. 4 hidden nodes form 3 independent one-sided ReLU gates feeding the output. 6 input splits (fbs:0, thal:7, sex:0, exang:1, cp:3, thalach). Weak spots: thal:3->3818 branch nearly inert; in gate 557 slope:3 suppresses risk (clinically counter-intuitive; rare 7%, no direct edge) - reported as what the network computes. Unconnected inputs (cp:2, fbs:1, restecg:1, restecg:2) added to root entries.
tool_bugs: get_formula renders output as ReLU. compute_shap at max_samples=100000 >2 min. SHAP gives exactly 0 for restecg:0 and exang:0 despite small nonzero direct weights. child_annotation_ids must be names.
summary: Essentially logistic regression: 19 direct edges (logit SD 4.90; ca +2.61, female -1.57) plus three one-sided ReLU corrections: an ischaemia gate on oldpeak and thal:7 (SD 0.78); a Boolean AND of female sex and exercise angina adding +2.07 logit, cancelling most of the female protective term (SD 0.56); a protective gate on high thalach mostly with non-anginal pain (SD 0.49). Linear core train AUC 0.930 vs 0.947 full; mean-ablating each gate gives 0.938, 0.940, 0.945.
